Method of Attack: Double-extortion ransomware attack involving data theft and encryption
Use of Linux encryptor targeting VMware ESXi virtual machines
Credential theft and lateral movement within networks
Deployment of encryptor after gaining access to Windows domain controller
Impacted Systems: Public computers and printing services at TPL
Corporate victims including Capita, Sobeys, Knauf, Yellow Pages Canada, ABB
Attack Vector: Initial access via malware (QBot partnership) and Cobalt Strike beacons
Credential theft and lateral network movement
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note found on TPL workstations
Outages in tpl:map passes and digital collections services
Limited email access disruption for employees not logged in
